title: Eczema flare follow-up

user_facing_items.final_wording: Covers itch, dry skin, erythema, vesicles, crusting, scaling, excoriation, lichenification, fissuring, age-linked distribution, atopy, sleep, and quality-of-life impact.
user_facing_items.population: Children and adults with atopic dermatitis complaints.
user_facing_items.setting: Telehealth services in DHA-licensed health facilities.
restrictions: Direct for Dubai telehealth atopic-dermatitis documentation; partial for every eczema or contact-dermatitis subtype.
user_facing_items.rationale: The UAE DHA atopic-dermatitis guideline directly supports documenting itch, dryness, flare course, morphology, distribution, atopy, sleep and quality-of-life impact during an eczema review without inferring current severity or cause.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Lists non-blanching rash, rapidly worsening painful eczema, fever or lethargy, respiratory distress, clustered blisters, punched-out erosions, recurrent infection, pregnancy, and psychosocial concerns.
user_facing_items.population: Children and adults with atopic dermatitis complaints.
user_facing_items.setting: Telehealth services in DHA-licensed health facilities.
restrictions: Direct for Dubai telehealth atopic-dermatitis documentation; partial for every eczema or contact-dermatitis subtype.
user_facing_items.rationale: The exact red-flag section supports recording rapid worsening, pain, fever, lethargy, blistering, infection, mucosal or systemic concern only when assessed, not asserting absence or generating escalation.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Covers clinician-led trigger reduction, skin-barrier care, education, and pharmacological choices; no medicine dose is mapped.
user_facing_items.population: Children and adults with atopic dermatitis complaints.
user_facing_items.setting: Telehealth services in DHA-licensed health facilities.
restrictions: Direct for Dubai telehealth atopic-dermatitis documentation; partial for every eczema or contact-dermatitis subtype.
user_facing_items.rationale: The management section supports recording a clinician-entered plan, discussion, safety net, and arranged follow-up without generating skin-care, medicine, dose, or referral advice.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports morphology and distribution review, atopy history, dry skin, selected non-routine tests, and differential-diagnosis assessment.
user_facing_items.population: Children and adults with atopic dermatitis complaints.

restrictions: Direct for Dubai telehealth atopic-dermatitis documentation; partial for every eczema or contact-dermatitis subtype.
user_facing_items.rationale: Morphology, distribution, differential, and selected investigation context were reviewed; no diagnosis or test is generated.
